issues: Hierarchy — Make the portfolio warning a quiet link that takes the user straight to the flagged project rows.
Density — Remove the repeated project count below the hero and tighten the mobile gap between the actions and project tools.
Consistency — Derive the header, priced count and project filters from the same project scope, rolling sub-projects into their visible parent where appropriate.
Clarity — Label the cap comparison as using priced projects and explain which of the other projects are empty versus awaiting prices.
Interaction — Add a trailing chevron to project links and keep it distinct from the row actions menu.
Accessibility — Announce warning counts as written. Omit the aggregate tag's generic percentage hint when it describes a child rather than the figure above it.
Responsive — Retain each project's cap amount below the percentage on phones and let the money and usage lines wrap independently.
Benchmark — Keep the active sort criterion visible on phones so a budget scan starts with a known ordering.
Hierarchy — Put the overallocated list caps in a named line below the project status so the warning is visible during a quick scan.
Density — Tighten the gap between the import buttons and the Lists heading to bring list rows closer to the budget summary.
Consistency — When a child list triggers the hero warning, give the warning an explicit child count even if the project is at the same warning level.
Clarity — Label the two values as combined list caps and project cap so the 100.000 € mismatch reads as allocated capacity.
Interaction — Replace the dotted cap amount as the sole in-context edit cue with a visible Edit project cap action beside the amount.
Accessibility — Give the cap edit control a 44 px touch target and include the cap mismatch in the accessible budget summary.
Responsive — Let Used and Left wrap at 320 px and retain each list's cap on a separate line beneath its amount.
Benchmark — Extend Needs attention filtering to folders with two or three lists so fixing a flagged list follows the same flow as Active Budgets.
Hierarchy — Add a compact ledger view that keeps a small running total and brings editable positions into the initial viewport.
Density — Start long ledgers with top-level section summaries and provide Expand all and Collapse all beside the category filter.
Typography — Increase the ledger header labels to 14 px and apply the designated code face consistently to OZ values on desktop and mobile.
Consistency — Give Menge and EP the same visible edit treatment and the same Enter to save and Escape to cancel behavior.
Clarity — Use All quantities 0 only when the quantities are actually zero. Show Not priced or 0,00 € when those explain the section total.
Interaction — Keep search and section navigation within reach while scrolling so a 197-position list can be edited without returning to the top.
Accessibility — Give the light theme's quantity and price focus rings at least 3:1 contrast and expose mobile field labels when the desktop table header is hidden.
Responsive — Stack the mobile row title above its numbers on narrow screens so long OZ codes, section names and totals can all be read.
Benchmark — Give the ledger keyboard navigation between editable cells and a discoverable shortcut to focus position search.
Density — Reduce the fixed autosave footer height and preserve the space for long-text reading.
Typography — Set the Kurztext field to wrap at every supported width and provide a height fallback for browsers without field-sizing.
Consistency — Render the category labels verbatim in the drawer breadcrumb, including suffixes such as ‘- I’ that appear in the ledger.
Clarity — Label the hero Gesamtpreis (GP), expand Einheitspreis (EP) at the form label and identify the headroom as the list's.
Interaction — Make both text edit affordances visible at rest and show a field error for invalid quantity or price entries instead of silently restoring the old value.
Accessibility — Give the inset Einheit control a 44 px target and an accessible name that says it edits the unit.
Responsive — Use a full-height editor while the on-screen keyboard is open and keep the focused field above it and the save footer.
Benchmark — Add Previous and Next keyboard shortcuts outside text fields and show their bindings in the drawer controls.
Hierarchy — Put the warning count next to the Needs attention control and let that count filter the displayed rows.
Density — Remove the repeated six-list count under the meter and keep it in the title subtitle and filtered list heading.
Consistency — Apply the same ancestor archive and trash exclusion as All Projects so lists in archived sub-project trees leave both active views.
Clarity — Label Left as combined headroom across capped lists, state how many lists feed that total, and keep uncapped lists visibly outside the cap comparison.
Interaction — Surface Edit list cap on the percentage-of-cap line so changing the budget is discoverable from this view.
Accessibility — Give every row a readable status word, including On track, and omit the generic aggregate percentage hint when the warning refers to individual lists.
Responsive — Keep the amount, cap, and usage together in the narrow layout and let long list names wrap above them.
Benchmark — Show euros left or over for each capped list, especially the list closest to its cap, so a user can act without calculating headroom.
Consistency — Replace the shared collection dock's Move to Archive action with Restore from Archive when viewing Archived.
Clarity — In the empty state, name the Archive action and say it lives on each project's options menu in All Projects.
Interaction — Surface Restore from Archive on populated rows and offer Undo after restoration.
Accessibility — After a keyboard restore removes a row, move focus to the next row or to Go to All Projects if the collection becomes empty.
Responsive — Let long project names wrap above row actions at narrow widths so users can identify the archived item before restoring it.
Benchmark — Show the archived date on populated rows and allow sorting by it so recent archivals are easy to find.
Hierarchy — Give Restore the visible row action and move Delete forever into a labeled options menu.
Density — Keep the empty state to a heading, one explanation and a return link. Show the row instructions only once items exist.
Consistency — Use the shared row grid for populated Trash to align project and list titles, metadata and action targets with collection rows.
Clarity — Remove the header's reference to a ••• menu while Restore and Delete forever are rendered as inline buttons. If the actions move, update the copy with their actual locations.
Interaction — Offer Undo after restoration so an accidental click is reversible without hunting for the restored item.
Accessibility — After a row is restored or deleted, focus the next row action or the empty state's return link and announce the change.
Responsive — Let the populated row actions wrap on small phones so their labels and 44 px targets fit without clipping.
Benchmark — Identify a trashed list's parent project and keep its deletion date visible, including on mobile, so similarly named lists can be told apart.
Density — Reduce desktop search result tiles and vertical padding so the next group remains visible below the first results.
Typography — Separate OZ and path into distinct text runs and use the designated monospace for OZ so the identifying code is easy to scan.
Consistency — Replace the bottom fade and heavy panel shadow with a solid footer divider and a visible scroll indicator in both themes.
Clarity — Show the capped result count alongside Positions 105 before expansion so users know how many matches the palette can display.
Interaction — Refresh the position index after imports, edits and removals so the palette opens the current position and quotes current prices.
Accessibility — Restore focus to the opener after Escape or Cancel and give the focused combobox an explicit, visible focus style.
Responsive — Allow two lines for the result path on phones and place the price line below it when the keyboard and screen width squeeze the result.
Benchmark — Add a keyboard-accessible List or Position scope so expanding a large position group keeps other result types one keystroke away.
Consistency — Use the shared flat overlay treatment for the creation toast and keep its dark surface in both themes.
Clarity — Replace price files with pricing spreadsheets and explain that New list starts a blank bill of quantities.
Interaction — Make the upload icon and instruction block an active file picker with a visible drop boundary on pointer entry and file drag.
Accessibility — Make the creation Undo reachable from the new page's keyboard sequence and keep its timer paused while focus moves through the toast.
Responsive — Reserve room for the creation toast on short phone viewports so it cannot cover Import files or New list.
Benchmark — Put the file-format details behind a compact disclosure and leave the primary import instruction immediately scannable.

global_issues: Make the list budget, project budget and priced coverage explicit and derive counts and archive exclusions from the same scopes.
Give the ledger a compact, keyboard-operable workflow with section navigation and visible edit states in both themes.
Refresh position search from current data and return focus when the palette closes.
Preserve imported category names verbatim and give rejected numeric edits a field-level error.
Align the recovery actions and copy in Archived and Trash with their actual row controls.
